old_caption: The video begins with a view of a metallic surface where numerous colorful golf balls are scattered. The balls come in various hues such as blue, green, yellow, red, pink, purple, and black, each with a textured surface resembling a golf ball's dimpled pattern. The metallic surface is part of a larger machine or apparatus, featuring a series of black clips or holders along its edge. As the camera moves forward and downward along the machine's curved structure, it reveals a transparent cylindrical section. Inside this section, several of the colorful golf balls are seen rolling down a ramp-like structure into the curved transparent section. The camera continues moving forward and downward, showing the balls rolling along the curved interior of the transparent section. The video concludes with a detailed view of the balls at the bottom of the cylinder, highlighting their vibrant colors and the smooth, reflective surfaces of the transparent section.

caption: A golf-ball rig fills the view: a white tray holds a loose cluster of dimpled balls in teal, silver, green, yellow, red, blue and magenta, while a right-hand rail carries black clamps beside dark balls. In the foreground a large curved transparent panel scoops around the tray, holding a magenta, a silver and a black ball, while a polished metallic cylinder sits at the upper right above the tray. The camera pushes in and swings toward the curved panel, so the multicolored tray and the cylinder slide out of the top of the frame. A white conical funnel rises into view on the right as the viewpoint tightens on the transparent surface. The magenta, silver and black balls on the panel appear to shift relative to one another and to the curve, the dark ball repositioning around the silver one as the viewpoint rotates. Reflections of the tray balls, including a purple blob at left and a cyan patch at the lower edge, stretch and reposition across the surface. Throughout the move the tray cluster keeps its loose arrangement, and the clamp fixtures remain fixed to the rail as the camera advances.
